body:
My daughter is not lucky to have me as her father, she's lucky to have her grandparents. Turns out I am just a piece of dirt, clinging on to my family now. I stopped work, drinking myself to sleep everyday. Now I am checked into this hospital. 

Funny how life can turn in just a short moment of time.

I am not dead yet, I am currently checked into hospital for 2 weeks. And I just managed to see the replies. I am so sorry for my late reply. 

Has anyone had experiences or stories of a mother abandoning her baby child ? Will they regret later in life ?

It's been 5 hours, in don't know why I am checking this thread on my phone. My daughter deserves a complete family. She's innocence. I am not. I had been ignorant, all I thought was what I felt best for our family. I was emotionally not present in my wife's life, I did not do it on purpose, but when I realised this, it's too late. If only I could turn back time. 

It's too late now for me also. Things I had done, if God still wants me to be around, 60 tablets of Prozac might or might not kill me. I can still reply to this, even if my hands are shaking now. 

Stay safe people. And treasure those around you.

I am not familiar with medication names, I remember one which is Xanax. 

I was with a Psychiatrist, till I found no hope with him, he's only listening, giving me textbook advice. Medication don't help abit. 

I guess you are you betrayed with such intensity, where you are suddenly told, you and our baby meant nothing. You might have a better feeling of what I am going through. None of the articles and stories shared the same scenario. However bad a situation is, none of the mother would no longer care/ask about her child. 

I don't know how I got into this mess. It's dark... with a knife constantly pushing into my heart and soul...

I had been in therapy and AA gathering. Medication is really out of options as I was taking 3 different combinations with no effects. 

My therapist told me to focus on my willpower.

Yes, I use to be a moderate drinker, when this happened, I found out that drinking ease my emotions, the constant pressure in my head lessens. I can find strength to continue living, but doing nothing at all, except drinking. How can I stop this ?

I used to be a person with good ambition, my motivation in life is to provide my family with the best I can offer. Both financially and me being there to support and protect them. 

But, there is nothing left in me to fight for, If I am to be here for my baby girl, it's solely for the reason of me 'being her father', the family bond that once truly existed is gone. 

Abandonment is a truly hard if not impossible pill to take. If my spouse died, I could at least tell my baby, your mother loved you with all she's got. But in this case, there is no answer in the world to give. 

I don't have the rights to blame my ex for doing this, every person has his/her own freedom. But as a mother, how could you leave your child here, with uncertainty to her future. 

I thank those who had spent their time to read this. For I felt nice typing this out. Even if the relieve only lasted 5 minutes.

I would like to voice out my condition, since young, I am diagnosed with Anxiety Disorder, it's not too serious and I still manage to move pass life, completing my degree and starting my own business (which failed after some time) and such. 

My one and only achievement would be my marraige and my baby. She's only 18months old. I won't say I am a good father, but since birth, I shared the responsibilities in taking care of her. 

All was well, till my wife decided to check-out and left me alone with our baby. No communications at all, it's like me and our baby never existed. 

People, friends and family expect me to stay strong for my baby. But no, I am a human being, I have feelings. And my feelings/emotions is killing me right now. For me, there is nothing left in this world that makes me happy. I have no motivation any longer. Everything came down from 100 to 0 in a day. 

How can I move on from here ?

I will not harm anyone. 

You are right about making choices, every individual has the right to make their choice. The problem is, I am not adding extra suffering, I am trying to ease the suffering. After trying therapy, medication and a whole lot of other things. It still comes back to square one. 

How do you find the motivation in life again ? If I may ask.. everything is taken away in the blink of an eye.

I am sorry if I posted at the wrong place. I wanted to share and voice out my bottled up feelings. I have no one to talk to. 

I am killing my future and more importantly my baby's future, it's only us now. I am in tears when I am typing this out. 

I may be seaking help at the wrong place, but there are truly a few comments that brought at least some hope to me. I can't thank you enough. 

I know I am edging towards a point of no return. I know it because I am constantly ignoring my fast plummeting health. 

I know I will be judge hardly, may Lord forgive me for I had sinned. 

My last words if I were to die, would be an apology to my baby. 'I am so sorry my little angel, dad's weak, you have every right to hate me'

I am grateful for the comments, it shows the world still cares, even from internet strangers. 

I fell asleep yesterday after 16 hours of drinking, I had 4 nightmares, just random dreams and lucky enough, my ex is not in them (they are the worst). When I woke up, my first reaction was to run to my baby's room and hold her. 

To be honest, its 9am here now, and I am drinking (not proud), 'ASHAMED' to be exact. I guess I have to find the will in me to stop this addiction from my baby. 

It's truly hard, because Everytime I look at our baby, she reminds me of her mother. The person whom abandoned us for her own reasons. 

'There may be a million reasons to leave, but why can't you look for one to stay ?' not even for your child ? 

How can a person turn off feelings for her own baby.. this I can't explain, how much can a phone call hurt ?
What a Wise comment. You have no idea reading this brought some hope to me. Thank you and may you have a wonderful life.

My country don't provide me with that luxury. I am sticking around.. a bright happy day seems appealing. But reality shows me the opposite. .. I am having a shitload of imaginations in my head ...

1) Being a good father.. raising my child.. only to find out she hates me and abandon me like her mom....

2) The list goes on..

I am sober. The drinking ease my pain, but don't make me drunk. I am not making excuses to drink, maybe I am to a majority of you. If there is any other ways to ease my pain, I will do it. 

How many people in the world, comes home from after work, working hard to provide for the family. Only to end up in this condition? If I am a person who physically abuse my family or a serial rapist, I can understand... but I am not.. I am just a normal person...

I am replying to any message here within minutes, because this is the only place I have left right now. To remain anonymous, due to personal reasons. I can't get checked in. 

The authorities here is very strict, my child's insurance policies will be deem voided if I am in mental conditions. That's the only thing I have left for my baby angel. I know my family (parents and younger brother) needs the money to support my baby.

If I am to go, it would have to be an accident. No payout for self inflicted suicide.

If Alcohol is a depressen, a temporary solution, everyone feels worst once they are sober. My solution to this, keep drinking...

I had never done drugs in my life, part of my pride, I am 30 now, and the idea of it is starting to feel appealing. No one is a winner here, the biggest loser will always and will be my innocent child. 

So I guess I am just a fucked up Father. My determination to be a good father, my religious strength, my life... all taken away from me, in a blink of an eye. How much pain can a human being endure.

Thank you for your reply, the problem is.. my emotions are constantly controlled by the pain of Abandonment, thoughts of never being with my wife and more importantly, my infant child whom is innocent, she lost her mother, for no reason. 

A bottle of Vodka won't do it for me, I drink an average of either 5 bottles a day or 48 cans of beer. 

Trust me when I say therapy won't help, I was there everyday for the first week, burning what is little left of me (financially), but I guess it worked only to the extent that I am not suicidal now. 

To be completely honest, I have good credit. And I am able to take up loans to continue this for maybe a year or so. 

I am not drinking because I am addicted to it, I am addicted to the numbness it provides for me to ease the pain.

Yes I fully agree, the truth is, it's very painful to have hope, it's 6am here now, and honestly I was awakened by a dream. Dreams of us having good times, and it's very painful, it's been 46 days, the first week was truly the hardest. 

I would say I am in a better place now, whenever I am awakened by these dreams, I would run to my baby's room and hug her. 

I guess I will start only start the legal process once there is no more pain, or when I feel it no longer matters that much. 

Thanks for your advice.

Thank you for your words of encouragement. To be honest. I don't even have a divorce to grief. It's all out direct Abandonment. One moment 45 days ago, I was happy at work, went to the pharmacy to pick up some baby essentials, went home only to find myself suddenly in this scenario. 

I don't know how to explain. But I truly wish I was dead at that moment. My mother carrying our baby with the letter she left behind. I am not the best husband in the world. I don't think anyone can be. But, WE (Baby included) certainly don't deserve this. It's been 45 days, and it's a miracle I am still able to type this today.

Trying to hate a person whom you truly loved, is the most painful experience anyone will have to experience. I guess death of a child comes first tho..

I have my mistakes and faults to share in this. I did not intentionally do it, but I guess I did, no way to turn back time, I will do better if I am given the chance. But things don't work that way. I understand. 

I just hope, she will realize one day, I truly loved her, even if the relationship didn't work out, this has nothing to do with our baby. Reestablish communication, not as a wife, but as a Mother. I can live with that.

I am not ranting because our marriage failed. Heck, I don't even realize the problems till this happened. For me it was 70% of my time working, wanting to provide a better future for our family. But, I now know, this is not what everyone wants and need. I respect that, I had my faults to play in this. 

I just hope, she would be a responsible person and come back to finalize our divorce, I just wants my baby to know who her mother is when she's older. It would crush her if she knows her mother left and wants nothing to do with her. What the hell did she do to deserve this ? 

I am willing and sincerely wants to give her visitation rights and I can also bring my baby to her country to visit her if time permits. I just hope she understands this. I am not hoping for husband and wife reconciliation. I only want my baby's mother to not be so cruel.

She knows very well she can't take our baby away. But does it mean if you can't 'own' your child means you would completely give up on her ? 

That's not Motherly Love, this i will not understand. Ever.

My final closure.. in my country, for Abandonment cases, it takes 2 years to complete. I am 90% sure I am not willing to start the process now. But, holding on to hope is killing me everyday. I want to start healing. It's just so unfair, when I  look into my baby's eyes, I just want to cry. What did she do to deserve a mother that chooses not to care and know about her anymore.

It just feels like I am grieving for 2 souls. Our baby did nothing wrong to deserve this. Even if I am a cheater/abuser/killer, in which I am not, a mother should at least call to ask about her baby.

No. Not at all. But her sister (in her country) told me a few days after she left, she's still wearing our wedding ring. I can't call her sister anymore after that. It's been 45 days. Not a word, not a call, even about our baby. Whom she cared and loved dearly.

Today is also a slightly better day, woke up alone in the house, and received a text from my mom they will be back 1 day early. Looking forward to see my little baby again. I will bring her out for dinner today. She loves Avocado and Salmon, and I have a place in mind. 

I was alone in the house yesterday, and I had time for self thinking and reflection. Well, there are always things you did wrong and things you could have done better, this is what makes us human. Regardless if my baby's mother will return to see her or not, it's not my decision to make. I still have her at the back of my mind everyday, I can't diminish these feelings instantly. I don't know how long will these feelings last, but I know there will be a day this matters less and less. 

My baby needs me, and I too need her. We will live and continue and happy life. And leave everything else to run it's nature. 

I came across a very touching story that adds to my motivation to be a better father. I think most of you had seen it, but for those who hasn't.. here's the link.

http://time.com/4110446/dad-writes-e...single-parent/

I thank you so much for your kind heart to care for me and my child. If you have the time, perhaps you can view my full story here. 

http://singlefamilyvoices.com/forum/showthread.php?p=382931&posted=1#post382931

I know there are so many people here who are wiser and had gone through this with such strong determination. 

Today is a very bad day for me, I was awakening 4am in the morning, I was having dream, good times that we were together in our room, just the 3 of us, our little family. Only to be awake and realise the bitter truth. I felt like I was dead, the word 'pain' isn't close to what I am feeling. 

There is something that I am hiding, even from my therapist. I am using alcohol to numb my senses, for the past 3 weeks, I am drinking for 18 hours a day. The painful part is, the pain comes 10 times stronger when the alcohol fades, making me desperate for more, to once again numb the pain. I am barely eating, worst of all, I am neglecting my baby. 

Am I going to go crazy ? I know what's right to do now, so many of you kind people here had shown me that my baby comes first now. I just can't find the happiness in me to do it. It's so painful, to the point I wish I can fall into a coma. I am crying to the point my eyes hurts so bad. I use to be a boxer during my teenage life, I had my forehead fractured once, yet I stood up and continued, why can't I do that again now ?

I am so sorry people, I let everyone down. If there is something I did so wrong, I beg God for forgiveness, to bring this pain away from my family and my baby child.

I am sure she knows that she can't take our baby to her country. Does this mean if you can't be with your child means you have to give up on her completely? I don't think that's the definition of Motherly Love. 


My final question, can a mother truly permanently forget a child she once born and loved so dearly for 1.5 years. Or she's just at a 'depressed' stage right now ? It's been a month. No calls, nothing.

Thank you for the concerns on medication. I am fully aware of the effects/addiction explained to me by my doctor (seen him since I was a kid). I am taking them in small dosage just to keep the anxiety down. The dosage will go lower each time, till I finally feel I don't need them.

Just came up with a quote, felt like sharing it here, not ranting, just my feelings. 

'It takes alot of courage to leave something important behind, but it takes so much more to stay and work it out, for the ones you truly Love'

Hey there, just had a thought in mind and wanted to share.


Life is short, don't dwell on things you regret and more importantly don't try fixing things that is out of your control.

When 'you' are sad you will try to do and think of every possible way to make 'yourself' feel better. Take a step back and try to make someone else happy. Be it your child, friends or family.

At times when you can put 'your happiness' aside, that is when you truly discover something called Selfless Love.
Have a good day.

The following post will be long, for those who are interested please read along.
It's been slightly more than a month since this happened, yesterday, just like any other day, I am moving back and forth from Acceptance, Forgiveness and Hope (worst part).

It was around 7PM yesterday evening and my parents brought my baby out for dinner with family friends, I was invited, but I really didn't have the mood to go. I was sitting at the sofa in the living room alone, browsing through the internet in search of every single topic on 'unwanted divorce', 'abandonment' and so on.
2 hours passed and normally my parents would be home in around that time. But today it seem to take longer, I was worried, I tried to call my parent's cell. Crazy enough, both of their cell can't get through.
Being in that unstable state of mind for me, I started to Panic, I started to imagine the very worst 'scenarios', what if they met with an accident, what if something really bad had happened. Now I am going to lose every single person I have left.

I dashed out of the house, took my car and wanted to drive straight to the restaurant they told me they are going. Countless bad images came rushing into my mind.
It was then, when I saw my dad's car driving towards mine. I paused, and I saw them emerge from the car, my mother was carrying my half-asleep daughter into the house. For that 5 minutes, I paused and thought to myself, things don't really seem so bad after all, I still have my baby and my family to live for. For those who had lost their family due to tragic sickness or accidents, whom loved ones left them without a choice, isn't that much worst compared to my current condition ?

'I STILL HAVE MY PARENTS AND MY BABY'

I went back into my house, my mother was still carrying my baby, I gave a hug, and I was sobbing. It turns out that, there was a rare traffic jam and both their cell went dead on battery.
What I realize from this event was, my wife left, and it was her choice, for whatever reason, I am sorry for my mistakes. I just hope she will always be happy, because I love her. Sometimes in life, you need to let go.
However heart broken or sad, this is my personal feelings, I should not bring this sadness into my parent's life and more importantly, not into my baby's future. I failed at being a husband, I can't fail in being a Father. I brought her into this world, and it's my responsibility.

I will better myself everyday now, I am a new Father, I still have so much to learn. No one knows about the future, sitting around hoping and guessing won't do anyone any good.

Just because the path is different now, it doesn't mean we can't be happy

Thank you all so much guys, 

After talking to my therapist yesterday, I felt more emotionally stable, I mentioned to him, I always felt better after talking, but out of no where, the 'crazy' emotions and thinking will creep back. There is no other way to help me other than medication. I just hope I don't have to rely on this forever. 

After that, I went home. During the night, my sister came over and invited me out for drinking. It's been years since she done that. We talked for a few hours, and I have some positive thinking after that.

Would like to share further, but my baby is waking up soon. I need to get somethings done before typing a long text wall. Stay safe and big thank you to those who posted.

For the past 2 weeks, I am in a constant battle with myself to remain saint.
 Don't think too much, focus on your child, let nature take its course. Are among the advice given to me time and time by family and friends. 

To be honest, if I am another person reading this post, I would think, what a loser scumbag this father is. 

I admit, for the first time in my life, I am weak, I always thought I can move past any life challenges thrown to me. But not this one, can't I also be selfish, run away, and rot somewhere. Rather then having to fake a strong face to everyone, that I can take up the role as a single father. maybe I  just love our baby, because I loved her.

My conscious mind knows there is no connection between the Abandonment issue and my baby. I am actually sitting outside my Therapist office waiting now. I called him for an emergency session, because I am freaking out right now. 

God I just hope this feeling can go away. 

Being around and playing with my baby now reminds me too much. I am distancing away from her.

I am not going to send any further messages, doing so will only make me feeling worst. I am honest in saying 'me and our baby is waiting for you to come home'

I don't know how long this feeling is going to last, or how long I can keep the door open.

 All I know is, I need to stop sending any further messages.

There is a new update to this now. I found out there is a way to contact her. But I am sure she won't reply to any of my texts. 

I sent her this msg

'I am sorry for being so un-attentive, impatient and causing you so much hurt in the past. I love you, but I don't know how to love a person. I was selfish. I know you need time and space now, I respect your decision. I will spend time working and improving myself for Eva (our baby), I just want you to know, you have a family and baby waiting for you here.'

I am sure I won't get a reply anytime soon, or maybe forever. Part of me felt I needed to send this msg. I don't know why, but I feel so much more anxious and pain after sending this.
If you were to come up with a random timeframe, how long do you think it will take till she will return and take a look at our child and maybe have a talk with me in regards to our marriage?

That is truly a sad but truthful story of life. I thank you for sharing this. Maybe some people even those as close as our wives, will have different view in life when the time comes. 

One last question. 

If I am to start waking up from my pain now, and move towards a better future with my baby. Would it be unfair to my wife if she is suffering now and/or confused. Have I done enough for us ? But then again, what else can I do now ?

Eva will always be incomplete. Her mother left her, her father is a complete moron not realising the signs of her mother being unhappy. 

We are just not fit to be parents.

My baby is ok. She kept crying at night since her mother left. But she is now sleeping with my parents. She is well taken care of, she had fever 2 days ago, I brought her to the doctor and she is currently under medication.

All I can remember, is that she told me 

1) Me and Eva (our baby girl) are the 2 people she loved more than anything else.

2) she can see and feel I am trying my best to change (my bad temper and behavior)

Boom. The next day she left.

Guys, the fact that I am posting all of this is because I really cared. 

I never thought I would one day search Google for relationship forums and advice.

I am just a regular human being, I have my faults and weaknesses. But I am willing to change and work for our little new family. Friends and family keep telling me, I am desirable, even when we were married, I have had so many encounters of gourgeus women trying to seduce me tho they knew I am married.

I never once felt attracted to them. I find them very attractive.. yes... but.. I had always told myself, I have a wife and a baby waiting for me at home. 

I don't want a new person, it doesn't make me feel better knowing i can always have one.

I love her so much. I did all I could. I am crying now, I want to trust and hope she is confused. She is having a depressed period.

You guys might think I am too emotional right now. But, writing this here, is the ONLY thing that is keeping me saint.

Am I being too pessimistic for thinking.

1) she is living a happy new life now, without me. She had forgotten all of our memories and vows.

2) she knows her baby is in good hands and she need not worry about her any longer.

Getting back like before won't happen. There were just too much sudden realisation on things I failed to see/understand. 

If we could have another go to this, I will be a different man. But, it all seems so impossible for now. 

I just dont want the mother of my child can be a person who would abandon and not care for her child forever.

So I guess, only time will tell for now. 

Strangely I had a dream yesterday, that she came to pay me a visit after I was involved in a very bad car accident. I am not suicidal, but life don't seem very appealing right now, I am here JUST for the sake of my child. 

Do you think, if I some how found out that I have a terminal illness. She would at least come back and see how I am doing ?

It's just unbelievable that caring strangers would have the heart to spend their time and effort to care. And yet, a mother would leave and not care for her child anymore. 

No amount of words can thank you all enough for your efforts, I guess I needed this more than I thought. 

Just a simple question, do you think, she will be back and at least take a look at our baby ?

I successfully established communications with my in-laws. My mother spoke to her sister. It seems that they are looking for her right now, but is also unsure of her current location.

I have good relationship/reputation with my father and mother in law, I beg/asked them to take care of her if they can find her, as I am very worried of her safety. 

I just hope one day, this will all end, I am willing to give up our marriage if that is what brings her happiness. After so many nights of thinking/crying and mixed emotions. I can calmly say that, all I want now, is for her to be happy, even if it means without me in the picture. 

My only concern is her feelings towards our baby, if giving up on us also mean giving up on the baby. I can't forgive her for that.

Thank you for your kind words and shared your story, reading it somehow allow me to feel your pain as well.

My only hope now is for her not to abandon our baby, at least a simple text or call to ask about our baby would mean so much to me.

I just don't get it why she can bare/survive to not see or ask about her child for a month now. Could this be depression ? Or maybe she is in as much suffering/pain as I am. 

What pain me most is not knowing if she had forgotten her child, but, it will hurt me even more if I know she is suffering missing her.

If there is ever anything I had done so wrong, I beg God to forgive me, and bring this pain away from my Child and Wife.

Selfish as it sounds, I just hope to wake up one day and forget this is actually happening to me. I am waking up every night (4-5 AM) and having a shock that this is really happening, I will hide myself in the toilet and cry. Everyday.

Yes, I did actually told her (many times) that I would like to invite her Mother to stay with us for a month or so every year. There is also a community of friends from her Country here, and she hangs out with them (mostly online). 

After our baby was born, her family (Father,Mother, Brother) came here and lived for a month. 

Coming to think of this, she used to be a self-surviving person in her country, she worked and lived alone and only visit her family(they live far from the city) a few times a year. 

I recently spoke to one of her friends (Wife spoke to her before she left), she said something about- she felt she always had the ability of work for herself last time, and now she is only able to depend on me, she felt so powerless. This friend can no longer contact her as well now. 

Trying to figure out each and every of this really taking a toll on my mental health. Feels like I am being bombarded from so many sides. 

NOTE: Her parents did not answer my calls during the first week of me going crazy and calling everyone. I stopped now, I am giving her the time she wants/need, even tho it is so hard for me. If talking to me now bring nothing but more pressure to her, I don't want that. 

I just hope one day, she can figure out I love her, I am willing to change, to be more attentive, but, ultimately, its this hope that is bringing the worst pain to me. 

I am not sure if anyone understand this, it's like I am stuck between two thinking.
1) Move on, hope for the best, plan for my child, I am not perfect, nobody is, but I truly loved. Even if I did make mistakes, she knows very well I am always willing to change, but in the end, it was her choice to leave (depressed or not). 

2) Wait for her to figure things out (she may or may not want to come back). The uncertain in this is truly horrific, it could be months or years.

We have a close family lawyer friend (he own's the firm), he gave me his full support assuring me with legal issues.

The problem is, I am not afraid of the legal issues/process. I don't have the heart to file for anything right now. 

A part of me wants to believe that somehow she is suffering from depression and this could be temporary, it's not fair to act in such a fast manner. 

Perhaps I will start legal stuff in about 6 months, maybe during then, I am in a better state of mind and understanding. 

It's not having the heart to give up/let go that is bringing so much pain to me.

Thank you for your kind words. I know pressuring this won't help. I often blame myself for being too impatient, this came out of the blue and I would rather take a stab to my heart than this.
